description: This Java class 'SearchSource' provides a stream-based mechanism to fetch search results for queries, supporting resumption, error handling, and retrieval of thing data from a distributed system using Akka streams and messaging.

classes.name: SearchSource
classes.description: Provides a stream of search results with support for resumption, error handling, and retrieval of thing data.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing SearchSource instances.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a stream of search results.

methods.name: startAsPair
methods.description: Starts a robust stream of search results paired with their IDs for resumption.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Determines if an error is recoverable or converts it into a runtime exception.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes streaming from the last thing ID.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Determines the next seed (last ID) for pagination.

methods.name: streamThingsFrom
methods.description: Streams 'StreamThings' starting from a given last thing ID.

methods.name: retrieveSortValues
methods.description: Retrieves sort values for a given thing ID.

methods.name: retrieveThingForElement
methods.description: Retrieves a thing's JSON data for a given ID, handling accessibility issues.

methods.name: retrieveThing
methods.description: Fetches a thing's JSON data with optional field selection.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Gets Ditto headers from the streamThings object.

methods.name: expectMsgClass
methods.description: Creates a flow that expects messages of a specific class, handling failures.
